No option can be put forward yet because the model cannot check your churn limit.

- The comparison is robust under the changes tested, but its result rests partly on four machine-supplied assumptions rather than your evidence, including active subscribers, new subscribers, churn, and feature-release value.
- The £20k MRR target was not scored either: its threshold frame and baseline are unspecified. The model also assumed that higher MRR is the objective.
- The most sensitive modelled drivers are active Pro subscribers and feature-release value; the latter is an Olumi estimate.
